definitions.gloss: to give birth; to deliver a baby
definitions.explanation: To bear a child. Used for both humans and animals, though for animals 産む is more common.

examples.japanese: {姉|あね}が{先月|せんげつ}{出産|しゅっさん}した。
examples.english: My older sister gave birth last month.

examples.japanese: {妻|つま}は{来年|らいねん}の{春|はる}に{出産|しゅっさん}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: My wife is due to give birth next spring.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて{出産|しゅっさん}するときは{不安|ふあん}なことが{多|おお}いと{思|おも}います。
examples.english: I think there are many things to worry about when giving birth for the first time.

notes:
A somewhat formal or medical-register word for giving birth. In casual conversation, {産|う}む is more common. {出産|しゅっさん}する emphasizes the event of childbirth as a process.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出産予定日|しゅっさんよていび}: due date
- {出産費用|しゅっさんひよう}: childbirth expenses
- {出産祝|しゅっさんいわ}い: baby shower gift; congratulatory gift for a birth
- {出産休暇|しゅっさんきゅうか}: maternity leave
- {無事|ぶじ}に{出産|しゅっさん}する: to give birth safely

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {産|う}む: to give birth — more colloquial, also used for animals and figuratively for creating/producing
- {分娩|ぶんべん}: delivery — medical term used by doctors and in hospitals
